summary.name: PyCoder's Weekly
summary.one_liner: A free weekly email newsletter delivering Python development news and links to articles, running since 2012.
use_cases: Staying current on the Python community
summary.what_it_does: The page promotes PyCoder's Weekly, a free weekly email newsletter covering Python development and topics around Python and its community. It sends curated news and links to the best Python articles. The page says it has served the Python community since 2012 and mentions a privacy policy. A sample is available via the latest issue (#758).
notable: Free weekly email newsletter running since 2012
Curated links to Python articles and news
Latest issue (#758) available as a sample
caveats: Delivered by email only; no web archive or app mentioned on the page
